chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: The private part of the believer is not exposed except that which is between the navel and the knees.
And for the woman, it is the whole body except for the two testicles.

key_terms.عَوْرَة: Private part; that which must be covered

ai.seo_question: What is the definition of awrah for men and women in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) definition of 'awrah, specifying the area between the navel and knees for men and the entire body except the face and hands for women, a view foundational to Shia jurisprudence on modesty. This narration underscores the theological emphasis on covering as an act of divine honor and protection, linking physical modesty to spiritual integrity.
